comment: Workload identities frozen at P2. Fixed tokenized prompts (fixtures) and generation length; batch/concurrency 1; speculation off; fixed tokenizer/checkpoint/cache dtype (fp16 cache). Early EOS must not shorten the work: generation runs a fixed 256 decode steps regardless of emitted tokens.
unsupported_context_policy: skip with explicit report; never change the denominator

measurements.prefill_s: time to process the prompt chunk(s), GPU events on the executing stream
measurements.tpot_s: steady decode time per token over the 256-token window (median)
measurements.peak_vram_bytes: hipMemGetInfo delta high-water mark during the run

microbench_shapes.comment: Layer shapes taken from configs/shape_manifest.json (actual checkpoint tensors). Representative = weighted by invocation count per decode step.
